Radius $OC = 8.507 - 5 = 3.507$ cm $\implies$ Area of sector $COD = \frac{1}{2}(3.507^2)(\frac{\pi}{5}) \approx 3.86\text{ cm}^2$.
walkthrough:
Calculate the angles, side lengths, and area of the right-angled triangle $OAB$:
$$\angle OAB = \frac{\pi}{2} - \frac{\pi}{5} = \frac{3\pi}{10} \text{ radians}$$
$$OA = \frac{5}{\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{5}\right)} \approx 8.5065 \text{ cm}, \quad OB = \frac{5}{\tan\left(\frac{\pi}{5}\right)} \approx 6.8819 \text{ cm}$$
$$\text{Area}(\triangle OAB) = \frac{1}{2} \times 5 \times 6.8819 \approx 17.2048 \text{ cm}^2$$

Calculate the area of sector $CAB$ (centre $A$, radius $AB = 5$ cm, angle $\frac{3\pi}{10}$):
$$\text{Area}(\text{sector } CAB) = \frac{1}{2}(5^2)\left(\frac{3\pi}{10}\right) = \frac{15\pi}{4} \approx 11.7810 \text{ cm}^2$$

Calculate the radius $OC$ and the area of sector $COD$ (centre $O$, angle $\frac{\pi}{5}$):
$$OC = OA - AC = 8.5065 - 5 = 3.5065 \text{ cm}$$
$$\text{Area}(\text{sector } COD) = \frac{1}{2}(3.5065^2)\left(\frac{\pi}{5}\right) \approx 3.8628 \text{ cm}^2$$

Subtract both sector areas from the triangle area to find the shaded area (to 3 significant figures):
$$\text{Shaded Area} = 17.2048 - 11.7810 - 3.8628 = 1.5610 \approx 1.56 \text{ cm}^2 \quad (\text{or } 1.57 \text{ cm}^2)$$
